widgets_values: A bright high-key portrait photograph of one young adult Asian woman reclining on a light grey sofa beside tall windows in a modern city apartment. She lies on her side propped on one elbow with her body angled diagonally across the frame, holding a round fan with a silver rim and white plum-blossom embroidery that trails a red tassel; her head tilts gently as she gazes at the lens with a soft, serene, faintly alluring expression. She has fair porcelain skin with realistic texture, softly coral-red lips, delicate features, and black hair in an elegant updo with a small red and gold hair ornament and a few loose strands. She wears a fitted bright red lace qipao-style mini dress with a gold-piped mandarin collar and traditional knotted buttons, short lace sleeves and a sheer openwork floral lace overlay that lets her skin read through the pattern, matched by long red lace gloves in the same openwork design. Behind her, large windows blur the city skyline into soft pale tones above the neutral grey sofa. Bright diffused daylight fills the scene with airy luminous highlights and gentle soft shadows, giving a fresh, refined, quietly elegant modern-oriental mood.
